label: D1 reward shown after a rewarded a2 choice, late in episode (trials ~70-89)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass); about 81% of mass comes when the rewarded previous choice was a2 (a1 gives only 2%). It is strongly tied to episode time: silent before trial ~55, rises through trials 60-79, peaks at 80-89 (62% of mass), and nearly vanishes at 90-99. It also lines up with mid-low model value (5.2-7.1) and a mild a2 policy bias. Magnitude is largest when the reward follows an unrewarded trial (prev trial reward 0: 29% of active steps hold 45% of mass, top activations are about 1.0 after r0 r0 then r1); after runs of rewards it is weak (about 0.01-0.15). It never fires at GO or D2, after no reward, or before trial ~55. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables (reward input, previous choice, trial index). Precision is limited (many late rewarded-a2 D1 steps stay silent, mostly ones inside reward streaks), so this is a partial explanation: a surprising-reward-for-a2 signal gated by episode time.
